StrategyDynamics 2.0 is live today.

It is a full rebuild, on iPhone and on the web, with one account for both.

One idea runs through all of it: the forward record decides. Build a system in plain words from 140 building blocks. Test it with real costs. Seat it forward and it runs on new bars every day, without touching a live account. Only then send it to your platform.

What is in 2.0:
Edge Finder hunts and Breed, to test ideas and cross the ones that survive.
Forward tests on new bars every day.
Portfolio tests, to judge your systems as one account.
9 stress tests, including a Monte Carlo of 400 futures.
Trade replay, bar by bar.
Bot export for cTrader, MT4, MT5, TradingView and Python, compile checked.

Most ideas die after costs. 2.0 shows you that instead of selling you a curve.

Starter £9.99, Pro £39, Institutional £149 a month.

Get 2.0 at strategydynamics.co.uk. Link in bio.

For education only. Trading involves risk.
